note: Window: 8 calls Q2 FY25-Q1 FY27 (all held; transcripts opened from ir.indegene.com). Q1 FY25 and Q4 FY24 added under rule 7 (outside_window). Company states a standing no-formal-guidance policy (Q4 FY24 p.6, Q1 FY26 p.16, Q2 FY26 p.11, Q4 FY26 p.10), so refusals are not recorded in class 9. Transcripts are company-edited 'for readability'; quotes were taken via a text-extraction tool, some are verbatim fragments and paraphrases are marked [para]. Score weights: 10 entries, weights 10->1, nulls (Q1 FY27, Q4 FY26) drop out: sum(grade x weight) 53.6 / (2 x 36) x 10 = 7.4. Rule 6: income-tax final assessment order AY 2023-24 (transfer pricing), demand Rs 43.69 cr incl. interest, intimated 5 May 2026; Rs 43.69 cr / FY26 PAT Rs 401.1 cr (last full FY before disclosure; audited results 30 Apr 2026, Q4 FY26 transcript p.8) = 10.9% >= 1% -> would be captured as a class-10 assurance ('does not expect any material adverse impact'), but the Reg 30 intimation itself was not opened [not retrieved: IR announcements page did not render; NSE/BSE copy not located]; known only from media reproductions (studycafe.in 6 May 2026, a2ztaxcorp.net 8 May 2026, filingreader.com 5 May 2026) whose impact wording differs [unverified] - not captured, outcome open (MAP/appeal). TCPA class-action settlement provision Rs 20.3 cr (exceptional, Q4 FY26) is captured from the call (Q4 FY26). No other penalty/order disclosures surfaced in search. No override applied (no contradicted class-10 assurance on a SEVERE issue). Q2 FY27 results not yet filed. Figures consolidated, Rs million unless stated; EBITDA excludes interest income from Q1 FY25 (definition change, Q1 FY25 p.7); 'adjusted' EBITDA excludes M&A, one-off and FY26 hedge MTM items per company.
